metadata.statistic: Median of the three process medians, each calculated from per-operation batch means. Raw p95Ms is the maximum of eleven batch means, not application request tail latency.
notes: Timed processes were run serially. Fixtures, hash calculation, and assertions are outside timed loops.
Diagnostics optimized run 1 was repeated after preserving the exact one-byte overflow behavior; its short-path output and benchmark data are unchanged in meaning.
The whitespace-heavy tool-output cases are adversarial valid inputs, not a typical user workload.
No whole-application latency, energy, peak memory, or leak improvement is claimed.

independentRepeatedExperiment.scope: Actual initializer source on isolated synthetic HTML; independent auditor measured an in-memory guarded candidate, then the checked-in probe verified edited production source.
